classified.text: The main candidate differentials are fibrous dysplasia, Paget disease of bone, chronic sclerosing osteomyelitis, and osteoid osteoma/osteoblastoma.

classified.text: This biopsy pattern is compatible with the sclerotic pagetoid variant of fibrous dysplasia described in monostotic lesions.

classified.text: The diagnosis that best integrates the age at onset, monostotic unilateral femoral involvement, chronic pain, leg-length discrepancy, imaging pattern, and exclusion of infection and malignancy is monostotic fibrous dysplasia of the femur.
